meaning:
σημειόω, -ῶ
(σημεῖον), [in LXX: Psa.4:6 (נָשָׂא)* ;]
to mark, note. Mid., to note for oneself: 2Th.3:14 (frequently in π.; see ICC, M, Th., in l).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man, that you have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.
